summary: FX audit service that scores bank or card-network FX rates against live mid-market rates.
access_note: Sign up and generate keys in the dashboard (ipx_live_ / ipx_test_); three free lifetime audits, MCP free tools capped per key; REST plans start at $99/mo.
blocker_note: Single-purpose FX audit API (three tools); REST usage beyond the free tier needs a paid plan.

evidence.quote: Authenticate every request using your production API key in the Authorization header.
Start free with three lifetime audits
REST API + SDKs for FX audit automation

notes: Docs pages were read through a summarizer, quotes taken from its output. ipayx.ai/docs returned a 404 page; used /developers and /docs/mcp-server instead. Small vendor; MCP endpoint is a Supabase function URL; 'rpc' reflects MCP over SSE.
